articles.summary: A $10,000 grant from Kearny Bank, through its KearnyBank Foundation, will support a financial education initiative operated by Interfaith Neighbors, an Asbury Park-based nonprofit.
articles.title: Interfaith Neighbors Nonprofit Receives $10K Kearny Bank Grant

articles.summary: The Table to Table food rescues mission, based in Saddle Brook, NJ, has received an $8,000 grant from Kearny Bank, though the KearnyBank Foundation.
articles.title: Table to Table Receives $8K Kearny Bank Grant
